name: V0
note: Initial bladder water 500 mL.

name: Dref_outer
note: Natural (unpressurised) OUTER diameter 70 mm.

name: Dref_inner
note: Natural INNER diameter 66 mm. The 2 mm per-side wall implied by 70-66 is the MOULD wall thickness; it is not the wall thickness once the bladder is filled.

name: Dmin
note: Minimum allowed bladder outer diameter 50 mm. A domain guard, not a plant coefficient.

name: cable_gap
note: Radial clearance from the cable to the bladder outer wall, 3 mm. Enters the geometry through D0/L0/xmax, not the ROM3 right-hand side directly.

name: material
note: Ecoflex 00-20.

name: material_confirmed_by_user
note: Material identity confirmed; its constants are still not measured on this build.

name: stress100
note: Stress at 100% elongation, used to set the Neo-Hookean mu.

name: pipe_diameter
note: 4 mm internal bore.

name: head
note: Bladder outlet is +0.10 m ABOVE the final outlet, so rho*g*h = +981 Pa ASSISTS the flow. The old snapshot value -0.1 is overridden at load time.

name: shaft_diameter
note: 5 mm bare shaft.

name: effective_radius
note: Bare winding radius 0.0025 m.

name: mass_equivalent
note: Non-motor equivalent translating mass 0.5 kg. Not measured.

name: damping
note: 20 N*s/m. Not identified.

name: friction
note: 0.1 N Coulomb level. Not identified.

name: friction_velocity
note: 1e-5 m/s regularisation velocity for the tanh friction law. Numerical, not physical.

name: force_max
note: 15 N. A LEGACY force-fixture limit. It is NOT the motor capability bound for this stage and must never be substituted for the torque-phase model.

name: contact_stiffness
note: 2e5 N/m button-to-bladder contact stiffness. Not identified.

name: Rh
note: BENCH EFFECTIVE RESISTANCE of the whole waterway at low flow: tube, valve, flowmeter and fittings lumped together. It is NOT a 4 mm outlet resistance and not an identified valve curve. Stage 9 uses it exactly as supplied and does not re-derive or re-check its calibration basis.

name: force_ramp
note: Not used by Stage 9.

name: pressure_reference
note: Lumped bladder-outlet gauge pressure.

name: mu
note: Neo-Hookean shear modulus. Datasheet-derived, not measured on the actual bladder.

name: Vsilicone
note: Silicone shell volume, added to the water volume before the equivalent sphere diameter is taken.

name: Vnatural
note: Natural internal cavity volume. Below it the spherical-shell extrapolation is unvalidated.

name: D0
note: Outer diameter at the initial 500 mL, 0.10034658601199008 m. y = pi*(D0-D(V)) is the cable coordinate.

name: L0
note: Reference cable length.

name: xmax
note: Travel limit used by the full reference model guards.

name: Vmin
note: Water volume at the 50 mm minimum outer diameter, 36.388 mL. Domain guard.

name: pipe_length
note: 0.36 m of straight tube.

name: R_tube
note: Theoretical laminar straight-tube resistance. Already CONTAINED in Rh, which is why alba9_loss subtracts it before adding the Darcy branch.

name: I_tube
note: Hydraulic inertance of the known straight tube.

name: tube_volume
note: 4.5239 mL of primed tube water.

name: cage_mass
note: Hoberman sphere mass 0.270 kg.

name: support_fraction
note: 1.0: the bladder carries the cage entirely.

name: gravity_height_slope
note: Conditional centroid-height law. pg already accounts for the cage weight; do NOT add a separate self-weight term.

name: selfweight_model
note: Name of the above law.

name: initial_contact_fact
note: The top button is always in contact with the bladder.

name: water_column_primed_assumption
note: Tubing is primed and bubble-free at t = 0.

name: quadratic_loss
note: Zero. Not identified. Zero does not prove the hardware has no local nonlinear loss.

name: version
note: Conditional reference, version tag.

name: nonlinear_pipe
note: Darcy branch enabled above Re_laminar.

name: pipe_absolute_roughness_m
note: Zero. A smooth-pipe assumption, not a measured roughness.

name: Re_laminar
note: 2000. Not a measured transition for this rig.

name: Re_turbulent
note: 4000. Cubic smooth blending between the two, also an assumption.

name: additional_component_K_Pa_s2_m6
note: Zero and unauthorised. Stage 9 does not add any unidentified valve or flowmeter nonlinear coefficient.

name: additional_component_K_authorized
note: false.

name: material_relaxation_enabled
note: false; no invented Ecoflex relaxation constants.

name: valve_scope
value_text: fully open; stop at a closing command, do not invent closure transients
note: Fully open; stop at a closing command.

name: fluid_scope
value_text: primed, bubble-free, rigid constant-bore tubing; forward liquid flow only
note: Primed, bubble-free, rigid bore, forward liquid flow only.

name: inertia_source
value_text: rho * sum(L_i/A_i), known straight tubes only; excludes unknown component inertance

name: roughness_source
value_text: smooth-pipe assumption, not a measured roughness

name: transition_source
value_text: engineering 2000/4000 thresholds with cubic smooth blending, not measured transition

name: component_loss_source
value_text: Rh_loaded minus calculated laminar straight-tube resistance; lumped residual, not an identified valve curve

name: additional_component_K_source
value_text: not identified; disabled, zero does not prove no local nonlinear loss

name: material_relaxation_source
value_text: not identified; no invented Ecoflex relaxation constants
note: Not identified; no Ecoflex relaxation constants were invented.

name: experimental_hardware_validation
note: false.

name: R_pipe_laminar_Pa_s_m3
note: Contained inside Rh. Subtracted before the Darcy branch is added, so the laminar tube loss is never counted twice.

name: R_residual_Pa_s_m3
note: Lumped remainder (valve, flowmeter, fittings, and any absorbed bias). A conditional decomposition of a fitted total, NOT an independently measured component resistance.

name: Ih_Pa_s2_m3
note: Known straight-tube inertance only. Excludes unknown component inertance.

name: motor_radius_m
note: Bare shaft winding radius.

name: steps_per_rev
note: Simulation uses 3200 STEP/rev. Stored as int64 in the MAT; must be cast to double before arithmetic.

name: ku
note: Cable taken up per commanded step.

name: stiffness_coefficients
note: Read from the MAT at full precision. Never retyped, never refitted in Stage 9.

name: stiffness_powers
note: Stored as int64 in the MAT; must be cast to double before use as an exponent.

name: audited_force_range
note: The range over which the LEARNED stiffness was checked positive. It is NOT a motor force limit and NOT a force saturation in the model. Exceeding it means the ROM is being used outside its audited domain, not that the hardware saturated.
